retained: no hard errors; round(score,2)>=7.0; no unresolved suspicious
motion: XY displacement / recorded replay dt; scalar-speed acceleration at interval midpoints
dynamics_limits: each real trajectory dynamics.v_max+0.03 m/s and dynamics.a_max+0.03 m/s²
turns: wrap adjacent increments before unwrapped cumulative sums; reversal=sum(abs(turn))-abs(sum(turn)); clip actual time boundaries
tail: extended=max(last 2 s,last 1 m); last 3 s independent; translation does not reset yaw statistics
pixel_pipeline: sequential full video decode; exact raw ordinals 0,N//2,N-1 and measured PTS; FFmpeg libavfilter scale=64:36, RGB24
black: largest 4-connected component with all RGB channels <=8, /2304, maximum sampled frame
frame_change: minimum MAE of neighboring sampled RGB frames, 0..255
terrain_correspondence: actual collected pose unchanged; XY/yaw/time checked against frozen plan, Z against archived NavMesh terrain-correction bound; remove only proved false legacy pose flag
raw_scan_role: immutable first-pass evidence; authoritative revised canonical scores in final_scores_index_uri
